newsitem.title: USA: US W.Coast spot gasoline prices track higher NYMEX.
newsitem.headline: US W.Coast spot gasoline prices track higher NYMEX.

text.p: Prices for U.S. West Coast gasoline firmed Thursday as the month's third-week deadline for pipeline scheduling approached, traders said.
CARB gasoline spot prices, which reflect what dealers charge at the pipeline, rose about two cents a gallon in California to between 78 and 79 cents a gallon.
Local markets tracked a slight gain in gasoline futures values, which closed 0.25 cents a gallon higher on the New York Mercantile Exchange (NYMEX).
Prices also rose after weekly data showed Tuesday showed a slight drop in West Coast gasoline inventories, according to the American Petroleum Institute (API).
Conventional unleaded gasoline prices were up in line with CARB and distillates also rose about one cent.
